## Interpretation

The dynamic Feshbach equations reconstruct the observed low eigenpairs, and the static Schur model `S0 = G - B^*C^(-1)B` already reproduces `mu1,mu2,mu3` within the registered tolerance. This makes the hidden effective 3x3 Schur correction the right next diagnostic object, not a standalone tail-level model.

The closest mode to the previous `nu_tail` is not the dominant self-energy contributor under the registered threshold, so the self-energy is classified as broad-tail rather than low-tail dominated.

No Route B kill follows from this audit. Boundary/admissibility and missing prolate branch basis are still separate unresolved receivers.
